sample_unit: pediatric clinicians (107 residents, 156 specialists) and 61 cases

links.outcome: AI model diagnostic accuracy compared with pediatric residents and specialists on the same cases
links.effect: ChatGPT 53/61 (86.9%), Gemini 50 (82.0%), Copilot 44 (72.1%); ChatGPT and Gemini exceeded the specialist median 95% CI upper bound (47.17); all three exceeded resident bound (42.76).
links.quote: Both ChatGPT and Gemini exceeded the upper bound of the specialist population median 95% CI (47.17).

screen.reason: The study compares diagnostic accuracy of multimodal AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot) with pediatric clinicians on clinical case vignettes, but does not test an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
